observations.body: The letter reads endurance in persecutions as evidence within God’s righteous judgment and names the Kingdom for which the community suffers.

payload.posture: Read 2 Thessalonians 1:3–12 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states the letter reads endurance in persecutions as evidence within God’s righteous judgment and names the Kingdom for which the community suffers. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
